name: NJM4556 / NJM4556A
type: Bipolar dual, high output current (70 mA)
tagline: JRC's 70 mA dual that drives 150 Ω directly: the paralleled output stage of NwAvGuy's O2 and a Japanese DIY staple.

lineage.note: Original non-A NJM4556 in DIP (D), SOP (M) and SIP (S/L). Yamaha 'YM4556D' house marks reportedly exist.
NJM4556A in D/M/V/L packages; datasheets Ver.2003-03-13 (JA), 2003-03-18 (EN), 2011-06-08, 2020-03-26. Own PSpice models.
Reported 保守品 in April 2023; 20250306 datasheets mark AD/AL as NRND. DMP8 and SSOP8 continue.

part_numbers.note: DIP8, Pd 700 mW. The O2 and FreeDSP-G part. NRND per 20250306 datasheet.
SIP8, Pd 800 mW. Sold by Akizuki (g111235) and LCSC (C78948).
DMP8, wider than JEDEC SOIC-8; Pd 300 mW. RS 2413462/2413463; Roland AC-90, smartstand.
SSOP8, Pd 250 mW. RS 2444515/2444516; Eurorack modules (Exits, HeadPho).
Original part, presumed obsolete. Seen on Namco System 12 boards and reportedly Yamaha RX7/RX15/RX21.
SIP8 original under the older suffix scheme; known from an Eagle library and one scan.
Different part, same number: decompensated (stable at ≥ 20 dB), 20 MHz, 5 V/µs, DIP8.

key_specs.value: 10 nV/√Hz typ; curve ≈8 nV/√Hz from 20 Hz to 1 kHz
key_specs.condition: curve: ±15 V, Rs=100 Ω, Av=40 dB
RL 200 Ω, 30 dB; 0.2% at 10 Vrms, 20 kHz

key_specs.value: 9 mA typ / 12 mA max per package
±70 mA into 150 Ω; graph ≈100 mA source, ≈200 mA sink
key_specs.condition: ±15 V; swing ±10.5 V min into 150 Ω

key_specs.value: 50 nA typ / 500 nA max; Ios 5 / 60 nA

key_specs.condition: Rin 5 MΩ typ; Avol 100 dB typ

reputation.summary: Valued for current drive, not a distinctive sound. NwAvGuy paralleled both halves per channel in the O2's output stage, reportedly saying it 'killed everything else' for current at low distortion. Japanese DIY calls it a standard (定番) chip that sounds surprisingly good for about 30 yen; one test found it more energetic but rougher than NJM4580.
typical_uses: O2 / ODA headphone amp output stage
Japanese DIY and kit headphone amps (aitendo)
Behringer UCA202 and Roland AC-90 phones outputs
caveats: DIP8 (AD) and SIP8 (AL) are NRND since March 2025; SMD AM and AV continue.
JRC DMP8 is wider than JEDEC SOIC-8; DMP8/SSOP8 dissipation is only 300/250 mW, so derate.
Modest speed (3 V/µs, 8 MHz); THD at 20 kHz rises steeply with output level.
High offset (6 mV max) and bias (500 nA max) matter in DC-coupled designs like the O2.
A vintage '4556' may be NEC's decompensated uPC4556 or a Yamaha part, not an NJM4556.

counterfeit_notes: No reports. DIP NJM4556AD circulates on eBay as '"Original" JRC'. Vintage '4556' may be NEC uPC4556 or Yamaha YM4556. Check: about ±11 V into 150 Ω at ±15 V, about 9 mA per package, stable as a follower. Buy authorized.
alternatives: LME49600 buffer inside a precision op-amp loop

silicon_changes.identification: Check prefix and logo, not digits: NEC 'uPC4556' (DIP8, C suffix) differs from JRC 'NJM4556'/'NJM4556A'.
silicon_changes.summary: Same '4556', different silicon. NEC's uPC4556 is a decompensated fast dual from its uPC4558 (20 MHz at gain > 20 dB, 5 V/µs), seen on late-1980s Taito boards. JRC's NJM4556/A is a compensated 70 mA / 150 Ω driver, used at unity gain in the O2.

spec_deltas.before: NJM4556A: internally compensated; used as a unity-gain buffer in the O2
spec_deltas.after: uPC4556: decompensated; GBW guaranteed only at gain >= 20 dB
not seen in datasheet summaries (no 150 ohm drive claim)

silicon_changes.audio_impact: A uPC4556 at unity gain (e.g. O2 buffer) risks oscillation; an NJM4556A in a high-gain vintage stage loses bandwidth and slew.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: high: decompensated part is no drop-in for unity-gain buffers; pinout same, stability needs differ.
silicon_changes.verification: Assembled from NEC datasheet mirrors (chipfind, alldatasheet); not independently confirmed.

silicon_changes.identification: NJM4556A_E 20250306 page 1: 'NJM4556AD and NJM4556AL are the NRND products.' AM (DMP8) and AV (SSOP8) not named. AD still stocked.
silicon_changes.summary: foxtango101 blog reported NJM4556A as 保守品 on 7 April 2023; the 2025-03-06 Nisshinbo datasheet marks DIP8 (AD) and SIP8 (AL) as NRND. Matches a March 2025 wave flagging DIPs (NJM2717D, NJM2392D, NJU7022D/7024D). No die or process change.
silicon_changes.audio_impact: None. Through-hole users (DIP-socketed O2 builds) face supply loss and may need SMD-on-adapter parts.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low: no silicon change, only DIP8/SIP8 availability risk; SMD versions continue.
silicon_changes.verification: Nisshinbo datasheet header confirms the blog report and narrows it to specific packages.

silicon_changes.identification: Marking NJM4556 / 4556 without 'A' is old. The A datasheet adds SSOP8 (AV). Non-A SIP appears as both NJM4556S and NJM4556L.
silicon_changes.summary: Part number moved from NJM4556 to NJM4556A before March 2003; non-A parts appear in 1980s–1990s gear. No document says whether this was a new die, process change or re-spec. Both share the 70 mA / 150 Ω title. A forum post calls the A 'the same as the original'.
silicon_changes.compatibility_risk: low (presumed): same role and 70 mA / 150 Ω headline; non-A detailed limits unverified.
silicon_changes.verification: No document explaining the A/non-A difference found; A datasheet dated 2003-03-18 (DigiKey mirror).

claims_confirmed: Current EN datasheet is 20250306 and states 'NJM4556AD and NJM4556AL are the NRND products' (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/pdf/datasheet/NJM4556A_E.pdf)
JA datasheet 20250306 exists; page-1 title shows no 保守品 line (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/ja/pdf/datasheet/NJM4556A_J.pdf)
Nisshinbo NJM4556A Series product page exists (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/products/operational-amplifier/spec/?product=njm4556a)
Mouser holds EN Ver.2020-03-26 listing AD/AM/AV/AL (https://www.mouser.com/datasheet/2/294/NJM4556A_E-1917507.pdf)
Datasheet: ±70 mA into 150 Ω (±10.5 V), ±2 to ±18 V, NJM4558 features plus 150 Ω drive (https://www.scribd.com/document/310047217/NJM4556A-E)
NJM4556AV-TE1: 8 MHz, 3 V/µs, 18 V, SSOP-8, active at RS (https://jp.rs-online.com/web/p/op-amps/2444515, https://se.rs-online.com/web/p/op-amps/2444516)
Nisshinbo publishes NRND/保守品 listing pages (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/en/design-support/discon/, https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/ja/design-support/discon/njx_discon.html)
foxtango101 reports NJM4556A among ex-JRC 保守品 op-amps (https://foxtango101.blog.jp/archives/19678237.html)
NJM4580_J 20250303 marks NJM4580D/L as 保守品, same wave (https://www.nisshinbo-microdevices.co.jp/ja/pdf/datasheet/NJM4580_J.pdf)
Non-A NJM4556 'Dual High Current' mirrors exist (https://www.alldatasheet.com/datasheet-pdf/pdf/7450/NJRC/NJM4556.html, https://www.datasheetbank.com/datasheet/JRC/NJM4556.html)
NEC uPC4556 is decompensated (20 MHz at > 20 dB, 5 V/µs), not an NJM4556 equivalent (https://www.chipfind.net/datasheet/nec/upc4556.htm)
O2 uses NJM4556A in its current-gain stage (http://nwavguy.blogspot.com/2011/08/o2-details.html, https://forum.lowyat.net/topic/2089195/all)
